headline: Iran killed 'more than 20' civilian mariners in recent months, rebutting Araghchi's denial'
dek: CENTCOM says Iran 'deliberately attacked civilian mariners at sea - killing more than 20 in recent months' and intentionally hit civilian infrastructure, neighbourhoods and facilities in neighbouring Gulf countries, calling Araghchi's claim that Iran has not attacked civilians in neighbouring…
sources: US Central Command (CENTCOM) statement/post on X
fault_line: Do 20+ dead mariners prove Iran deliberately targets civilians at sea, or does the unattributed IMO tally show both sides killing sailors in the same waterway?

sections.what_happened: CENTCOM says Iran 'deliberately attacked civilian mariners at sea - killing more than 20 in recent months' and intentionally hit civilian infrastructure, neighbourhoods and facilities in neighbouring Gulf countries, calling Araghchi's claim that Iran has not attacked civilians in neighbouring countries 'FALSE'.
sections.what_verified: Statement itself confirmed by CENTCOM X post as carried by AJ liveblog, Gulf News liveblog and Kurdistan24. Kurdistan24 has NO declared tier in the source registry, so it is reported with attribution only and does NOT count toward corroboration. The IMO tally CENTCOM leans on does not attribute the deaths to Iran.
sections.what_disputed: IMO public tally reported by AFP on 2026-08-25: at least 20 seafarers or port workers killed, 35 wounded, 1 missing in 68 incidents in/around Hormuz over six months - responsibility NOT assigned; UKMTO classified 47 of those incidents as attacks; USNI News noted the IMO count covered attacks by BOTH Iranian and US forces. IMO in May: Iran's attacks killed at least 10 seafarers (via AJ). Iran's merchant mariners union told AJ at least 44 Iranian seafarers/fishermen/dock workers were killed 2026-02-28 to 2026-04-01 in US/Israeli attacks (unverified). Iran's Foreign Ministry had not responded at time of reporting.
sections.why_matters: Claim-bust Short: 'CENTCOM says 20+. The IMO count it leans on does not say that.' Hard number in title + the unattributed-tally reveal.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 05:15 GMT = 09:15 ; Gulf News liveblog 09:36 ) -- CENTCOM: Iran killed 'more than 20' civilian mariners in recent months, rebutting Araghchi's denial

totw_analysis: Our read: Claim-bust Short: 'CENTCOM says 20+. The IMO count it leans on does not say that.' Hard number in title + the unattributed-tally reveal. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Do 20+ dead mariners prove Iran deliberately targets civilians at sea, or does the unattributed IMO tally show both sides killing sailors in the same waterway?
